memory_candidates.content: In the BimodalLogic repository, any plan whose phases edit a .lean file incurs a generated doc-sync obligation the research phase will not surface: plan-file-scope-harvest.sh augments the harvested file_scope with typst/generated/status.typ and every registered README generated-inventory block covering the touched directory's ancestor chain. These are machine-owned and gated (scripts/typst-sync-check.sh for status.typ, check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory --check for the README blocks), so a Lean plan that omits a regeneration step fails its final gate after every substantive phase has already committed. Note the ordering constraint: typst-sync-check.sh --fix reads a per-declaration axiom report out of the build, so it must run AFTER the unscoped build, not before. Planning technique: run plan-file-scope-harvest.sh against the draft plan and reconcile its output against the declared Files to modify blocks before returning; a harvested path absent from the declarations is a missing phase task, not harvester noise.
